texts.preamble: Smt. Shilpa. M vs Raveesh K H on 9 January, 2023 Crl.Misc.No. 218/2016 In The Court Of Metropolitan Magistrate Traffic Court-I At Mayohall Bangalore Present : Smt.Rekha H C Metropolitan Magistrate Traffic Court-I Bengaluru Dated This 09th January 2023 Crl.Misc.No.218/2016 Petitioner: 1. Smt. Shilpa. M W/o Raveesh K.H D/o Manjunath Aged about 29 years 2. Sinchana R. D/o Raveesh K.H Aged about 6 years 3. Hemanth R. S/o Raveesh K.H Aged about 5 years Since petitioner No.2&3 are minors Rep.by Minor Guardian Smt. Shilpa M. Petitioner No.1 All are resident of No:9 Near Sree Saraswathi Vidyalaya School Hennur Bande, Kalyannagar Bengaluru-560043 (Advocate Sri Vl) V/S Respondent: Raveesh K H. S/o Late Hanume Gowda Aged about 32 years R/at No: Karenahalli Village Crl.Misc.No. 218/2016 Kalya Gate, Magadi Taluk Ramanagar District
texts.facts: The Petitioner No.1 to 3 filed petition against Respondent U/sec.12 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act by seeking maintenance of Rs. 15,000/-p.m, Rs.5,000/-p.m towards educational expenses, Rs.10,000/- p.m for rent, Rs.30,000/- towards monthly expenses, Rs.1,00,000/- for litigation expenses and compensation of Rs.5,00,000/-. 2. The petition averments briefly stated as follows: The marriage between petitioner No.1 and respondent was solemnized on 05.11.2009 at Siddarudeshrama Kalyana Mantappa, Magadi, after the marriage the petitioner No.1 started to reside with the respondent and his family. Out of the marriage wedlock they begotten two children. At the time of the marriage petitioner has given 100 gms of gold, and cash of Rs.75,000/- and spent Rs.6,00,000/- towards marriage expenses. After the birth of second petitioner, the respondent started harassing the petitioner physically and mentally for dowry and picked up quarrels for the same. After the advice by panchayatdars the respondent gave an Crl.Misc.No. 218/2016 undertaking that he will not harass the petitioner No.1. The respondent threatened that he will kill her daughter, assaulted and harrassed the petitioner No.1 to bring dowry. The respondent used to bring his friends to his house for drinking alcohol and when petitioner No.1 advised not to continue such activities in the house the respondent assaulted the petitioner No.1 with bottle and threatended the petitioner No.1 to 3 with dire consequences. The entire expenses of the family was born by the father of the petitioner and the respondent used to spend all his money on drinks. The petitioner No.1 is subjected to physical and mental cruelty by the respondent, unable to withstand the torture and there were nobody to take care of the petitioner and her children which has become very difficult to lead the life. Hence the petition. 3. After the serving of notice Respondent appeared before the Court and filed objections. In the objection the respondent denied all the allegations levelled against him. The respondent submitted that when the petitioner had been to the delivery of the second child she started to show her true colours and neglected the respondent's family by making unwarranted allegations against respondent and her mother in law. The petitioner No.1 also scolded for spending medical needs of her mother in law. The petitioner No.1 choose to quarrel with respondent on filmsy grounds. The petitioner No.1 is running one Bangle store business which was setup by respondnet and till today the entire income is Crl.Misc.No. 218/2016 taken by her. The petitioner No.1 in the month of June 2016 willfullly have deserted her husband and residing with her parents. All the allegation of the petitioner have conveniently been framed with no truth in the same with the children being the witness for the same. Hence prays to dismiss the petition.
texts.arguments: As per section 2 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005; 2(a) "aggrrieved person" means any woman who is, or has been, in a domestic relationship with the respondent and who alleges to have been subjected to any act of domestic violence by the respondent; 2(s) "shared household" means a household where the person aggrieved lives or at any stage has lived in a domestic relationship either singly or along with the respondent and includes such a household whether owned or tenated either jointly by the aggrieved person and the respondent, or owned, or tenanted by either of then respondent, or owned or tenanted by either of then in respect of which either the aggrieved person or the respondent or both jointly orsingly have any right, title, interest or equity and includes such a household which may belong to the joint family of which the respondent is a member, irrespective of whether the respondent or the aggrieved person has any right, title or interest in the Crl.Misc.No. 218/2016 shared household.
